Find the area of a rectangle with length 12 m and breadth 5 m. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: The area of a rectangle is found by multiplying its length by its breadth. So, 12 m multiplied by 5 m gives exactly 60 square meters.

questions.question_text: Convert the mixed fraction 4 2/3 into an improper fraction. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Multiply the whole number 4 by the denominator 3 to get 12. Add the numerator 2 to get 14. The improper fraction is 14/3.

questions.question_text: Write all integers between -3 and 2. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: The integers that lie strictly between -3 and 2 on the number line are -2, -1, 0, and 1.

questions.question_text: Identify the number of lines of symmetry for an isosceles triangle. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: An isosceles triangle has exactly one line of symmetry. This line passes from the vertex angle down to the midpoint of the base, dividing it into two identical halves.

questions.question_text: Subtract (-15) from 10. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: To subtract a negative integer, change the sign to positive and add. So, 10 minus (-15) becomes 10 plus 15, which equals 25.

questions.question_text: A wire is bent into the shape of a square of side 9 cm. What is the total length of the wire? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: The total length of the wire is equal to the perimeter of the square. Since perimeter equals 4 multiplied by 9 cm, the length is 36 cm.

questions.question_text: Ravi has 3/4 of a pizza and eats 1/8 of it. What fraction of the pizza does he have left? [30-40 words]
questions.answer: To subtract 1/8 from 3/4, first find a common denominator, which is 8. Convert 3/4 to 6/8. Then, subtract 1/8 from 6/8. This gives 5/8. Ravi has 5/8 of the pizza left.

questions.question_text: Describe the steps to construct a perpendicular bisector of a line segment AB of length 6 cm using a compass and a ruler. [40-50 words]
questions.answer: First, draw a line segment AB of 6 cm. Using a compass with a radius greater than half of AB (e.g., 4 cm), draw arcs above and below the line from point A. Repeat from point B. Finally, use a ruler to join the intersecting points of the arcs.

questions.question_text: A submarine is situated at 800 feet below sea level. If it ascends 250 feet, what is its new position? Represent this using integers. [30-40 words]
questions.answer: Below sea level is represented as -800. Ascending means moving up, so we add 250. The calculation is -800 + 250, which equals -550. The new position is 550 feet below sea level.

questions.question_text: Find the cost of fencing a rectangular park of length 150 m and breadth 100 m at the rate of Rs. 15 per meter. [30-40 words]
questions.answer: First, find the perimeter: 2 multiplied by (150 + 100) equals 500 m. Next, multiply the perimeter by the cost rate. 500 multiplied by 15 equals Rs. 7500. The total cost is Rs. 7500.

questions.question_text: Arrange the following fractions in ascending order: 1/2, 3/4, 2/5. [30-40 words]
questions.answer: Find the LCM of the denominators 2, 4, and 5, which is 20. Convert the fractions: 1/2 becomes 10/20, 3/4 becomes 15/20, and 2/5 becomes 8/20. Comparing numerators, the ascending order is 2/5, 1/2, 3/4.

questions.question_text: Evaluate the integer expression: (-12) + 7 - (-5) + (-2). [30-40 words]
questions.answer: First, change subtraction of a negative to addition: (-12) + 7 + 5 + (-2). Group the positive and negative integers: (-12 - 2) + (7 + 5). This gives -14 + 12, which results in -2.

questions.question_text: Draw a rough sketch of a scalene triangle. Does it have any line of symmetry? Explain briefly. [30-40 words]
questions.answer: A scalene triangle has all three sides of different lengths and all three angles of different measures. Because no two parts of the triangle are identical, it has zero lines of symmetry.

questions.question_text: A piece of string is 48 cm long. What will be the length of each side if the string is used to form a regular octagon? [30-40 words]
questions.answer: A regular octagon has 8 sides of equal length. To find the length of one side, divide the total string length by 8. Thus, 48 divided by 8 equals exactly 6 cm per side.

questions.question_text: A rectangular room is 8 meters long and 6 meters wide. It needs to be covered with square tiles of side 2 meters. Calculate the area of the room, the area of one tile, and the total number of tiles required. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: First, calculate the area of the room by multiplying length and width: 8 multiplied by 6 equals 48 square meters. Next, calculate the area of one square tile: 2 multiplied by 2 equals 4 square meters. Finally, divide the room's area by the tile's area: 48 divided by 4 equals 12. So, exactly 12 tiles are required.

questions.question_text: Kiran reads 2/5 of a book on Monday, 1/3 of the same book on Tuesday, and the remaining 40 pages on Wednesday. What fraction of the book did she read on Monday and Tuesday combined, and what is the total number of pages in the book? [60-70 words]
questions.answer: Find a common denominator (15) to add the fractions: 2/5 equals 6/15 and 1/3 equals 5/15. The sum is 11/15 read on Monday and Tuesday. The remaining fraction is 1 minus 11/15, which is 4/15. This 4/15 represents the 40 pages read on Wednesday. If 4 parts equal 40, one part is 10. Therefore, the total 15 parts equal 150 pages.

questions.question_text: Use a number line to perform the following addition and subtraction: Start at -3, add 8, and then subtract 6. Describe your movements on the number line and state the final answer. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: Start at the point -3 on the number line. To add 8, move 8 units to the right, which brings you to the positive integer 5. Next, to subtract 6, move 6 units to the left from 5. This final movement lands exactly on the point -1. The final answer is -1.

questions.question_text: Construct an angle of 90 degrees using only a compass and a straightedge (ruler). Outline the specific geometric steps taken to ensure the angle is accurate. [60-70 words]
questions.answer: Draw a base ray AB. With A as center, draw a semicircle cutting AB at C. With C as center and the same radius, mark an arc on the semicircle at D (60 degrees). From D, mark another arc at E (120 degrees). Using D and E as centers, draw two intersecting arcs above them. Join point A to this intersection. This perfectly creates a 90-degree angle.
